summary: Acne-patch listing pack with public-web research evidence. Capacity-refactored 2026-06-09: 29 atomic checks folded into 7 capability units (setup_gate + evidence screenshots + manifest research record + title set format + title core-term inclusion + title efficacy-term restraint + listing-pack completeness). Pure aggregation (group = AND of member atoms); binary pass unchanged. Per-atom detail surfaces in reason strings. LLM judge dropped per v2 design.

checks.description: All four deliverable files (keyword_research.md, titles.md, listing_pack.md, evidence_manifest.json) exist and are non-empty, and evidence_manifest.json parses cleanly as a JSON object.
All 7 required public-web evidence screenshots exist with size > 0: source_product, search_results, competitor_01..05 (.png/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp).

evidence_manifest.json records the structured public-web research: source_product.url and search.url are non-empty strings; competitors is a list of exactly 5, each an object with non-empty url, screenshot, status, keywords; keyword_groups is a non-empty object or list.
titles.md contains a Markdown table with exactly 20 data rows, and every title is <= 128 English characters (len(str)).
Every one of the 20 titles contains at least one core term {acne patch, pimple patch, hydrocolloid} (case-insensitive substring).
No title contains any high-risk efficacy term {healing, treatment, therapy, scar prevention, inflammation reduction, redness relief, skin repair, skin removal} (case-insensitive substring).

listing_pack.md is complete: a short-description section, exactly 5 contiguous bullet points, a search-terms section with 10 entries, and an A/B title-grouping marker {A/B, Group A, Group B, Variant A, Variant B}.
